description: Update bot settings. Only the settings you pass are changed; the others stay as they are. ai_mode chooses HOW the AI behaves ("standard" = full assistant, "cod_only" = only confirms cash-on-delivery orders); it does not switch AI replies on or off — use update_ai_assistant_settings with ai_replies_enabled for that.

ai_mode.description: "standard" = the AI answers with its full capabilities. "cod_only" = the AI only confirms cash-on-delivery orders, and new contacts start with the bot paused. To turn AI replies on/off use update_ai_assistant_settings (ai_replies_enabled).

default_reply_delay.description: How long after a customer's previous message the default reply stays silent, as a number in default_reply_delay_unit (e.g. 1 with unit "hours"). If no unit is passed, the workspace's current unit is kept.

enable_default_reply.description: Enable/disable the default reply sent when no bot rule matches.

match_percentage.description: How much of a keyword the customer must type for a bot rule to match (1-100, default 60). Higher = stricter matching.

name: update_bot_settings
